body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'NAB Show 2009') -- <Visual News> [No-Edit NAB 2009] SIDSA, a fabless company specialized in digital TV receiver chipsets, presented a professional receiver at 2009 NAB Show.

The receiver has been validated in cooperation with the company TeamCast, a renowned provider of digital TV transmission equipment that has developed a complete DVB-SH modulator supporting all modes. The DVB-SH receiver from SIDSA and the transmitter from TeamCast thus become a reference for satellite network operators and consumer electronics companies.
SIDSA has also announced the launch a chipset with the complete DVB-SH standard during the show. The company expects that the market massively takes off in 2010.

TeamCast is proud to acknowledge that the DVB-SH core technology presented at NAB 2009 is already in use in the pilot hybrid networks deployed in the USA by ICO Global Communications, and demonstrated with great success at the CES 2009 show.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'NAB Show 2009' : Idea Kim, Kevin Choi, Miso Kim >
